messages.subject: Calderdale House — your VAT option to tax (action needed before completion)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

To preserve the TOGC treatment (so no VAT is charged on the £8.45m price), Ellwood Estates needs to (1) opt to tax the property and (2) notify HMRC before completion, plus give the article 5(2A) notification. I've prepared the VAT1614A and the TOGC notice — please sign the attached copies I've sent to your PA and we'll submit to HMRC and get the acknowledgement on file. This must be done before 28 March.

Thanks,
Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
